University courses

ASU Universal Learner Courses

Current offer. Institutional coursework can complement alternative-credit plans. Admitted degree-seeking ASU students are not eligible for this route.

Research profile · confirm exact school and course acceptance

How the credit works

Arizona State University academic credit after successful completion and optional credit purchase.

Pace and learning format

Asynchronous sessions or on-demand courses. On-demand minimums depend on credits: six weeks for three/four credits, four weeks for two, two weeks for one.

Costs to check

Official pricing lists $25 enrollment plus an optional $400 credit-conversion payment per course ($425 if converted).

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Assessment and proctoring vary by course; required proctored assessments use Honorlock. Check prerequisites and release schedules.

Before you commit

  • Choose the exact receiving school, degree, and catalog year.
  • Confirm this specific course, recommendation or transcript source—not only the provider’s name.
  • Ask which requirement the learning will satisfy and check duplicate-credit, grade, date, and source limits.
  • Keep a written school decision before paying for an outside course you need for graduation.
